note: RV-only park near the south-west end of Gull Lake: grassed sites 60-80 ft long and about 40 ft wide, an 18-hole mini golf, two playgrounds and a horseshoe pitch; firewood delivered to the site. One family per site (2 adults and their children); no tents or tent trailers. --Claude
